URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/keir-starmer-andy-burnham-prime-minister-downing-street-b3018119.html
NOTE: Independent live blog (21 Jul 2026, 07:00) — Burnham cuts VAT on domestic electricity from 1 Oct as first major policy; Chancellor John Healey says funded by cancelling the Digital ID programme; full confirmed Cabinet list.

Andy Burnham has announced a fresh tax cut to remove VAT from domestic electricity bills from 1 October, the first in what is expected to be a series of policy announcements on Tuesday morning.
Chancellor John Healey said the cut would be funded from cancelling the Digital ID programme. "For too long, too many people have struggled with the cost of living," he said. "Today's energy tax cut will give families some breathing room on bills, and provide some reassurance this winter."

- Ed Miliband — Foreign Secretary
- Louise Haigh — First Secretary of State, Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, Minister for the Cabinet Office
